zh.name: 李智鑫
zh.title: 青年副研究员
zh.affiliation: 复旦大学 · 金融科技研究院
zh.description: 李智鑫，复旦大学金融科技研究院青年副研究员。研究方向包括金融科技、时序图异常检测、多智能体、金融大模型推理优化与金融风险管理。
intro: 李智鑫，工学博士，复旦大学金融科技研究院青年副研究员，2024年9月入职复旦大学。现兼任上海市数据跨境应用基础研究创新中心副主任、复旦大学金融科技研究院办公室副主任。
研究围绕人工智能赋能金融风险管理展开，关注复杂交易网络中的异常识别、跨机构隐私保护与可信协同，以及大模型和多智能体技术在金融场景中的应用。相关工作涉及图异常检测、反洗钱基准构建、联邦学习、合成数据与大模型安全。
zh.keywords: 金融科技；时序图异常检测；多智能体；金融大模型推理优化；金融风险管理；AI4FinTech。

news.text: CR-Aug 与 TransXion 发表于 KDD 2026，分别关注图异常检测与反洗钱图基准。
FedDDIM 获 ITQM 2026 最佳论文奖，本人为通讯作者。
担任上海市数据跨境应用基础研究创新中心副主任。

research.title: 时序图学习与金融风险识别
research.text: 面向资金交易和复杂关系网络，研究图异常检测、动态风险识别、反洗钱基准及合成交易数据。

research.title: 隐私保护与可信协同
research.text: 研究联邦学习、隐私保护与跨机构协同建模，关注数据共享受限条件下的金融风险识别。

research.title: 多智能体与金融风险仿真
research.text: 关注金融场景中智能体的交互行为、策略演化与风险传播，探索可控实验与仿真验证方法。

research.title: 金融大模型与推理优化
research.text: 关注大模型在金融场景中的推理效率、安全与可信应用，研究面向具体任务的模型适配和优化。

en.name: Zhixin Li
en.title: Associate Researcher (Young Scholar)
en.affiliation: Institute of Financial Technology · Fudan University
en.description: Zhixin Li is an Associate Researcher (Young Scholar) at Fudan University. His interests include FinTech, temporal graph anomaly detection, multi-agent systems, LLM inference optimization, and financial risk management.
intro: I am an Associate Researcher (Young Scholar) at the Institute of Financial Technology, Fudan University. I hold a doctoral degree in engineering and joined Fudan in September 2024. I also serve as Deputy Director of the Shanghai Basic Research Innovation Center for Cross-Border Data Applications and Deputy Director of the Office of the Institute of Financial Technology.

My research focuses on AI for financial risk management, with an emphasis on anomaly detection in complex transaction networks, privacy-preserving collaboration across institutions, and the application of large language models and multi-agent systems to finance. My work spans graph anomaly detection, anti-money laundering benchmarks, federated learning, synthetic data, and LLM security.
en.keywords: FinTech; Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection; Multi-Agent Systems; Inference Optimization for Financial Large Language Models; Financial Risk Management; AI4FinTech.

news.text: CR-Aug and TransXion appeared at KDD 2026, addressing graph anomaly detection and realistic anti-money laundering benchmarks.
FedDDIM received the ITQM 2026 Best Paper Award. I am the corresponding author.
Appointed Deputy Director of the Shanghai Basic Research Innovation Center for Cross-Border Data Applications.

research.title: Temporal graph learning and financial risk identification
research.text: Graph anomaly detection, dynamic risk identification, anti-money laundering benchmarks, and synthetic transaction data for complex financial networks.

research.title: Privacy-preserving and trustworthy collaboration
research.text: Federated learning, privacy protection, and collaborative modeling across institutions under constraints on data sharing.

research.title: Multi-agent systems and financial risk simulation
research.text: Agent interactions, strategic behavior, and risk propagation in financial settings, with an emphasis on controlled experimentation and simulation.

research.title: Financial LLMs and inference optimization
research.text: Efficient inference, security, and trustworthy use of large language models in finance, including task-specific adaptation and optimization.
